question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **somewhere**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Somewhere **means an unspecified or unknown place. (एक अनिर्दिष्ट या अज्ञात स्थान)

 
 
• **For example**: *She wandered through the forest, hoping to find the hidden treasure somewhere among the trees.*
 
 
 
• "Somewhere" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it indicates a general location without being too specific which is meaningful in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete passage**: *Redwing had read **(1) somewhere__** that one of his favourite writers, Ernest Hemingway, had been asked what was the best (2) ______ for a novelist. He had said "an unhappy childhood". Redwing had enjoyed a fine time growing up, but he (3) ______ if this whole (4) ______ was unfolding more like a novel, and would be (5) ______ on one person, one character, the guy in charge: him. Maybe you got a happy childhood and then an unhappy adulthood, and that's how novels worked.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Wholesome **means healthy or beneficial, which does not fit the context of the sentence. (स्वस्थ या लाभकारी)
 
• **Negligently **means carelessly or recklessly, which is the opposite of what the sentence is trying to convey. (लापरवाही से या असावधानी से)
 
• **Careless **is a possible option, but it implies a lack of attention or concern, which may not be the intended meaning of the sentence. (ध्यान या चिंता की कमी)
